scientific_integrity: The claim is based on two explicitly supplied complementary exact state recurrences and a complete optimized-start census. Computed results are reproducible by the included standard-library programs; no external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for visible-robber Cops and Robbers on the thirty-vertex incidence graph of W(2,2), with passes allowed; finite exhaustive proof, no assertion for other generalized quadrangles. Publisher full text of the 2012 design-derived-graphs paper was not accessible, so residual prior-art risk remains.
title: Three-round pursuit and 70 optimal placements on the Tutte–Coxeter graph
